objectives: 神經生物學課程旨在講授神經細胞之生理、生化，及各類神經系統包括感官、動作、睡眠、情緒、學習等。
content:
時間 	課程主題
1. Organization of the vertebrate brain
2.Cellular elements and organization of the nervous system
3.Neurophysiology: resting potential/ action potential
4. Neurophysiology: synaptic transmission
5.Visual system
6.Auditory system
7.Motor system
8.Mid-term report (No class)
9. Chemical control of the Brain and Behavior
10.Motivation
11.Emotion
12.Circadian rhythm and sleep
13.Memory system
14.Oral presentation
15.Oral presentation
16.Oral presentation
18.Reading assignment ＆ final report (自主學習)
books:
Neuroscience: Exploring the Brain, Fourth Edition by Bear et al. (2015)
Case Files Neurology, Third Edition by Toy et al. (2017)
Case Files Neuroscience, Second Edition by Toy et al. (2014)
